summary: Executed Iter69 follow-up acceptance on public preview URL. Backend targeted suite passed for multi-creator, privacy, foreign-release denial, shared-track joint wording, long-content PDF pagination/render, and unit rollback compensation. Frontend Playwright partially validated signature mandatory-after-clear but full submit flow remained flaky due repeated modal-open instability.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure opening 'Buat Tiket Support' modal after clicking 'Tiket Baru' (2/3 retries timed out on modal visibility during automation).

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete deterministic browser run because modal-open instability occurred before final submit in repeated runs.

issues: Browser console hydration warning: invalid nested markup rendered inside <option> (span child).

action_items: Investigate intermittent modal-open behavior for support ticket creation button on /label/support.
Fix invalid markup in release <option> rendering to remove hydration warning.
After UI fix, rerun full Playwright submit+document-view flow across 320/768/1024/1440.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend content-id pipeline now satisfies key acceptance scenarios: per-creator docs, independent NIK/track scope, shared-track joint wording, authz privacy, and rollback compensation behavior.
Rollback unit path confirms failed PDF upload does not persist declaration/request and restores staged asset state.
Frontend support modal intermittency is currently the main blocker for deterministic UI acceptance automation.

success_rate.frontend: 45% (login + partial form/signature checks passed; modal-open instability blocked full deterministic e2e)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary synthetic KTP/signature fixtures at /app/tests/iter69_ui_assets for QA-only uploads; no permanent account creation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter69_content_id_followup.py as regression baseline. PDF artifacts required by acceptance are saved at /app/test_reports/iter68_final_sample.pdf and /app/test_reports/iter68_final_rendered/. Playwright attempts hit repeated [support-ticket-modal] visibility timeout from new-ticket click; stop condition triggered after repeated selector failures.
rca of the issue: Frontend RCA (observed): support-ticket modal opening is flaky in browser automation despite visible and clickable trigger button; symptom appears as timeout waiting for dialog visibility. In one run modal opened and progressed, in subsequent runs same selector path failed. Potential causes: dialog state race/animation timing, click handler non-determinism, or overlay/focus interception. Repro: login label fixture -> /label/support -> click [support-new-ticket-button] -> intermittently no [support-ticket-modal].
